faq_heading: Homes near Betty Huff Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Betty Huff Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Betty Huff Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Betty Huff Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Betty Huff Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 66 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,178,500, townhomes $670,000, condos $389,048. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Betty Huff Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Betty Huff Elementary the median was 34 days on the market, closing at 95.7% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 66 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Betty Huff Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are David Brankin Elementary (0.6 km south-west), A H P Matthew Elementary (0.9 km north-east) and Senator Reid Elementary (1.0 km west).

Betty Huff Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13055 Huntley Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Betty Huff Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Betty Huff Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Betty Huff Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Betty Huff Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 66 homes sold within 1 km of Betty Huff Elementary: 23 houses, 22 townhomes and 18 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,178,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Betty Huff Elementary

33 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Betty Huff Elementary in a straight line (20 elementary, 11 secondary, 2 other; 6 independent). The closest is David Brankin Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Honour Secondary School, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Queen Elizabeth Secondary (1.0 km); the nearest independent school is Sikh Academy (1.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (1.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: David Brankin Elementary (0.6 km south-west), A H P Matthew Elementary (0.9 km north-east), Senator Reid Elementary (1.0 km west), Cindrich Elementary (1.0 km south-east), Creekside Elementary (1.6 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is David Brankin Elementary, 0.6 km south-west of Betty Huff Elementary.
